# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a buggy or carriage  <sub>[v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews is a member of the Andrews family in Avonlea and the brother of Jane Andrews. He once drove a buggy carrying Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Jane Andrews to White Sands for a concert. During that drive, he showed a distinct admiration for Anne by insisting that she sit next to him.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011)_
